name: Miuka
source:
Her blunt words, spoken without filter have left countless customers disheartened. However, no harm is meant—it's just her style!

She lives and takes care of her younger sister.

She has been a cast member longer than the other two.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden/en/]official website[/url]]
